fields.Name: T205 - Required Field Validation Error
fields.Description: Attempts to save a new record with a required field left empty and verifies the app surfaces a validation error gracefully rather than crashing.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the 'Members' entity grid — type 'Members' in the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box and click the EXACT 'Members' match (or navigate to http://localhost:4200/app/data-explorer/Data?entity=Members). Click the 'New Record' (New/Create) button to open a blank Member form. WITHOUT filling the required fields (those marked with a red asterisk *), click Save. Verify the app responds with a clear VALIDATION message indicating required field(s) are missing (e.g. a field-level error or a 'required' message) and does NOT crash, show a blank screen, or save an invalid record. Reaching that validation-blocked state is success. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: A new record form was opened and Save attempted with required field(s) empty
The app surfaced a clear validation/required-field message and blocked the invalid save
No crash, blank screen, or raw server error — handled gracefully
